hints: Identify the vertical scale factor by comparing the vertical dimensions/peaks of the solid and dashed graphs.
Identify the horizontal shift by tracking corresponding key features (such as intercepts or vertices).
walkthrough:
Observe the vertical scaling between corresponding points on the solid graph $y = f(x)$ and the broken-line graph:
Each $y$-coordinate has been multiplied by $3$, representing a stretch in the $y$-direction (parallel to the $y$-axis) with scale factor $3$.

Observe the horizontal displacement:
The graph has been shifted $4$ units to the right, representing a translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}$.

ai_rubric.Graph Transformations: States stretch in $y$-direction (parallel to $y$-axis) with factor $3$ (B2). States translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}$ (or 4 units right) (B2).

hints: Combine the horizontal translation of $+4$ ($x \to x - 4$) and vertical stretch factor $3$ into an equation for $y$ in terms of $f(x)$.
walkthrough:
Apply the horizontal translation to the function argument ($x \to x - 4$) and the vertical stretch by multiplying the entire function by $3$:
$$y = 3f(x - 4)$$
